lastChange.note: Round 3: the colour hold lifted for status only, with soft green, yellow and red tokens (status-ok, status-wait, status-bad and their wash, track, arc, mark, dot and tag forms) and map-window. New cards: Gauge (the tinted ring on phases, milestones and sprints; tapping it folds its section), StatusMark (corner mark and tinted tag on events and steps), BranchMap (the whole phase floating at the top, panning under a window over the events in view) and PhaseRow (one row of phase gauges under the map). LaneGraph kept, but replaced by BranchMap on the timeline. The owner's rulings of 15 November 2026, decisions/questions/P-005-design-round-3.md.
